column2: Traders are able to act and transact without interference from the government.
Industry is free from government interference
In general this is a free market economy but the government reserves the right to intervene when the national interest requires it.
The State controls the commanding heights of the economy but limited free enterprise is allowed.
The government makes all decisions on the production and consumption of goods and services.
Total separation between church and state, religion is purely a private matter.
Religion is not explicitly part of state policy, but the state tips it hat to traditional religious values.
The state religion is actively promoted but other religions are tolerated.
Church and state are a single body, and religious minorities face discrimination.
Only people of your nation's primary culture are allowed the vote.
Only people of your nation's primary and accepted cultures are allowed the vote.
The military is the centrepiece of the state and military spending is prioritised.
The government is a strong supporter of the armed services.
The armed forces are a drain on the state coffers and the government feels money is better spent elsewhere.
The government is actively hostile to the interests of the military, feeling they are opposed to the government policies.
Aristocrats or capitalists have been assigned seats in the Upper House by the leader of the country.
Only members of the ruling party with the same ideology can be appointed to represent the party in the Upper House.
Each state has two votes to appoint representatives to the Upper House.
Representatives are determined by the collected ideologies of the population.
No one is allowed to vote.
Only aristocrats and Capitalists may vote.
Only the wealthy (clerks and above) may vote, but the rich men's votes are worth twice as much as middle-class votes.
Only the middle and upper classes may vote.
Everyone is allowed to vote, but the rich men's votes are worth more.
The candidate with the most votes wins.
The Jefferson Method is a highest averages method for allocating seats.
The percentage of votes that groups of candidates obtain in elections equals the percentage of seats they receive
Public meetings and rallies are allowed.
While allowed a relative amount of freedom, the press is still censored by the government.
Free press is allowed without interference from the government.
The government controls the trade unions.
The government actively prevents other parties from publicly campaigning for votes.
The ruling party harasses people into voting for them.

Electoral district or constituency boundaries are deliberately modified for electoral purposes, meaning the votes for the ruling party are worth more. The ruling party can use gerrymandering in order to get people to vote for them.
The voter's choices are non-confidential. The ruling party knows who the people vote for and can use pressure in order to get the people to vote for them.
The voter's choices are confidential in order to prevent others from influencing the voter by bribery or intimidation. The ruling party can't affect the way people votes.
Minimum wages are acceptable to most people.
Minimum wages are above the normal.
No limit on working hours per day.
There are no safety regulations at all.
There are safety regulations governing lethal tasks.
There are safety regulations governing dangerous tasks.
There are safety regulations governing all physical tasks.
There is a full-blown safety regulation system.
There are really a lot of Public Schools.
